operating_direction.implementation_rule: Implementation defects are corrected and rerun; they are not economic failures.
operating_direction.application: The closed V1 root stays immutable while this sibling completes the same declared experiment. Invalidity requires a genuine inability to satisfy the frozen semantic, causal, topology, or integrity contract, not exhaustion of a repair count.

implementation_policy_alignment.binding_procedural_effect: Any conflicting unit-local compile-correction count, same-family-repair prohibition, or invalid-after-count wording is procedurally superseded.

authority.user_boundary_direction: Research boundaries are whole experiments, not implementation steps; do not impose an arbitrary one-correction limit and do not split work into meaningless micro units.

selection_rationale.post_094_map: No new Unit 095 was opened. The current authoritative surfaces do not jointly provide exact causal inputs, a frozen contrast, actionable TRUE and FALSE decisions, and sufficient distance from closed axes.
selection_rationale.unfinished_contract_precedence: Unit 062 already has exact inputs, a complete intervention, fixed gates, conditional execution order, both terminal decisions, and no economic verdict. Completing that existing whole experiment precedes opening a newly proposed unit.
selection_rationale.deferred_new_lead: A separately proposed SLOOS credit-supply role is not part of Unit 062 and receives no authority here; it may be reconsidered only after Unit 062 closes and the whole map is recomputed.
